title: Litigation risk and strategic M&A valuations

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (mergers involving publicly traded U.S. firms across two-digit SIC industries)
context.time_period: 2000-2015 (main sample; extended through 2018 in additional analysis)
context.sample_size: 1,490 mergers with 1,579 target-sought FOs (PPP sample); 1,406 mergers with 1,434 FOs (DCF-to-Deal Price sample)

data_sources.name: Hand-collected target-sought FO valuations and merger negotiation process details from 'Background of the Merger' section
Courthouse News Service (appraisal petitions filed in Delaware Chancery Court)

analyses.label: Table 3, Column 1 (main DiD; DV = PPP; Post2007)

dv.name: Peer Portfolio Percentile (PPP)
dv.source: Hand-collected from SEC filings (FO peer comparables); peer valuation multiples (EVS) from Compustat
